Which option correctly reports the question? 'What time do you finish work?' she asked me.
options: She asked me what time I finish work.
She asked me what time do I finish work.
She asked me what time did I finish work.
She asked me what time I was finishing work.
questions.answer: She asked me what time I finish work.
